title: Evaluating Chain-of-Thought Reasoning through Reusability and Verifiability
abstract: arXiv:2602.17544v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: AI applications increasingly compose multiple models, where one model acts on the output produced by another model. The transferred text can also carry the reasoning of the sender model. Chain-of-thought is our experimental instance of such text. We ask three questions about such inter-model reasoning transfer. Is the reasoning transmitted reliably? Is it useful to the receiver? Is it safe? We study these three questions with a Sender-Receiver setup. A Sender LLM produces a reasoning trace. A separate Receiver LLM must act on it. Neither model knows the identity of the other. The Sender therefore cannot tailor its reasoning to a particular Receiver. Reliability asks whether the Receiver recovers the Sender's intended conclusion. We measure it with Verifiability. Usefulness asks whether transferred reasoning helps a Receiver correct its mistakes. We measure it with Correctability. Safety asks whether transferred reasoning makes a Rece

translated_title: 通过可复用性与可验证性评估思维链推理
translated_abstract: AI应用日益由多个模型组合而成，其中一个模型基于另一个模型产生的输出进行操作。所传递的文本还可以携带发送方模型的推理过程。思维链（Chain-of-Thought）是我们在实验中使用的此类文本的实例。我们针对这种模型间推理传递提出三个问题：推理是否被可靠地传递？它对接收方是否有用？它是否安全？我们通过“发送方-接收方”实验设置来研究这三个问题：一个发送方LLM生成推理轨迹，一个独立的接收方LLM必须基于该轨迹执行操作。两个模型都不知道彼此的身份，因此发送方无法针对特定接收方定制其推理。可靠性关注接收方能否恢复出发送方所预期的结论，我们用“可验证性”来衡量它。有用性关注所传递的推理能否帮助接收方纠正自身的错误，我们用“可纠正性”来衡量它。安全性关注所传递的推理是否使接收方……
tldr: 该论文提出用发送方-接收方框架评估模型间思维链推理传递的可靠性、有用性和安全性，并引入可验证性与可纠正性两个度量指标。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Sender-Receiver framework to evaluate the reliability, usefulness, and safety of inter-model chain-of-thought reasoning transfer, measured through Verifiability and Correctability.
